source_uncertainties: Optional managed advice/prefetch path compiled but did not execute because actual concurrentManagedAccess=0; no full-support platform or migration benchmark available.
Timings describe this bounded WSL laptop protocol and do not identify internal staging, bus, scheduling or generated-code causes.
Current web runtime documentation is13.4; memory API signatures were verified separately against installed13.3 headers.
The256float declaration is verified from slide; the public chapter computes1024bytes without alleging an unverified spoken256byte error.
No OOM/capacity-exhaustion, multi-device, cache-latency, copy/compute-overlap, cuBLAS or Tensor Core benchmark performed.
